name: gizza-ai/js-minify
summary: Minify JavaScript by stripping whitespace and comments

tool.description: Minify JavaScript: remove unnecessary whitespace, line breaks and comments to shrink the source, while preserving behavior. It is token-aware — strings, template literals and regular expressions are kept verbatim, identifiers are never renamed, and code is never reordered or dropped, so the minified output is semantically identical to the input. Newlines that matter for automatic semicolon insertion (e.g. after return) are preserved. remove_comments (default true) strips comments; keep_license (default true) still preserves /*! … */ / @license / @preserve banner comments. Runs locally.

remove_comments.description: Strip line and block comments. Default true.

keep_license.description: When removing comments, still preserve license/banner comments (/*! … */, @license, @preserve). Default true.
